method: Chromium SwiftShader software, 480x320 DPR1, 16 alternating hot synchronized gl.finish/readPixels samples per version/scene/profile. No concurrent graphic workload. Camera, date, wind time and snow cover asserted equal. Logical GL allocation is not physical VRAM; heap includes inspection.

allocation.method: Instrumented WebGL2 bufferData/deleteBuffer and texture storage/mipmap/delete calls. Logical storage, texture estimate with depth24 conservatively counted as 4 B/texel. Excludes driver/compression/framebuffer defaults; not physical VRAM.
